author: niko_timi
quote: I flew in the sky 4 times, fell inside the bridge, fell under the map twice, some creature multiplied itself and attached to me. The worst sims campaign ever. Can’t do a thing to protesters, lgbtq supporters, 24 fps average (went to around 15 on loaded places), terrible texture loading, the mouth don’t match the words half the time, voice acting is not good, cars feel slow, saturation is horrible, copied assets, COPIED RDR2 ANIMATIONS, bad written charecters, npc bugs, frame drops, terrible animations (half the time you don’t even touch the item or object, game is so blurry.                                                                                                         Rockstar had over a decade since GTA V and a massive budget to refine their formula they've been perfecting for 25 years. Cyberpunk had a fraction of that time and money while taking a huge creative swing building their first-ever FPS sci-fi RPG from scratch and trying to force it onto aging last-gen consoles.Rockstar had the time, experience, pedigree and money to meet the expectations and they fell short on everything.
